FINAL IVX INVESTMENT CARD + POST CARD + REELS CARD
END-TO-END TRANSACTION QA, REPAIR, DEPLOYMENT, AND LIVE VERIFICATION

EXECUTE NOW.
DO NOT RETURN ONLY A UI REPORT.
DO NOT MARK VERIFIED FROM SCREENSHOT REVIEW OR UNIT TESTS ALONE.

The Casa Rosario investment card and every other live IVX investment card
must be audited as a real financial transaction interface.

The required result is:

DISPLAY
→ INTERACTION
→ AUTHORIZATION
→ DEAL VALIDATION
→ INVESTMENT SELECTION
→ PAYMENT
→ TRANSACTION
→ OWNERSHIP
→ RECEIPT
→ INVESTOR PORTFOLIO
→ DEAL TOTAL UPDATE
→ AUDIT LEDGER
→ POST/REELS SYNCHRONIZATION
→ LIVE PROOF

==================================================
1. IDENTIFY THE CANONICAL CARD IMPLEMENTATION
==================================================

Find every component used for:

- main landing investment card
- authenticated home investment card
- deal-detail card
- investor dashboard card
- Post card
- Reels investment overlay
- saved/favorite card
- buyer card
- JV card
- tokenized investment card

Return:

CARD COMPONENT:
FILE:
ROUTE:
API:
DATABASE TABLES:
CANONICAL DEAL ID:
DATA SOURCE:
MOBILE/WEB SHARED OR SEPARATE:
DUPLICATE IMPLEMENTATIONS:
DEPRECATED IMPLEMENTATIONS:

There must be one canonical deal data contract.

Do not maintain separate hardcoded card data in:

- landing page
- app home
- Reels
- deal details
- investor dashboard

==================================================
2. VISUAL AND DATA AUDIT
==================================================

Audit every visible field shown on the card:

- active status
- image count
- project images
- title
- city/state
- sale price
- total investment
- ROI
- timeline
- current stage
- progress
- estimated completion
- minimum investment
- minimum ownership
- Tokenized badge
- JV Deal badge
- Buyer badge
- developer
- Details control
- View Deal
- Invest Now
- like count
- comment count
- link/share action
- save/favorite
- Reels shortcut

For every field return:

DISPLAY FIELD:
SOURCE TABLE:
SOURCE COLUMN:
API FIELD:
FORMATTER:
FALLBACK:
CURRENT LIVE VALUE:
VALID / INVALID / MISSING / HARDCODED:

No card may display placeholder financial data as production fact.

==================================================
3. FINANCIAL CALCULATION VERIFICATION
==================================================

Audit all financial values and formulas.

For Casa Rosario specifically verify:

SALE PRICE:
TOTAL INVESTMENT:
TARGET CAPITAL:
CURRENT CAPITAL RAISED:
MINIMUM INVESTMENT:
MINIMUM OWNERSHIP:
ROI:
EXPECTED PROFIT:
INVESTOR DISTRIBUTION:
IVX FEES:
DEVELOPER FEES:
CLOSING COSTS:
PAYMENT FEES:

Verify that:

ownership percentage =
investor accepted amount / approved equity valuation basis

Do not calculate ownership automatically from sale price unless that is
the approved legal and business model.

For the displayed example:

Minimum investment: $50.00
Minimum ownership: 0.0005%

Return the exact calculation and approved valuation basis proving whether
0.0005% is correct.

If not correct:

- remove it from production immediately
- replace it with an accurate value
- or display “Calculated during checkout” until legally approved

Do not display estimated ROI as guaranteed return.

Use appropriate wording:

- Target ROI
- Projected ROI
- Estimated return

depending on the approved offering documentation.

==================================================
4. BADGE FUNCTIONALITY
==================================================

Audit the three visible badges:

TOKENIZED
JV DEAL
BUYER

Each badge must be either:

A. A true classification indicator
or
B. A functional navigation/filter/action control

Return for each:

BADGE:
DATABASE SOURCE:
MEANING:
CLICKABLE:
DESTINATION:
USER ELIGIBILITY:
VISIBLE FOR WHICH DEAL TYPES:
TEST RESULT:

Do not show all three badges on every deal unless the deal genuinely
supports all three pathways.

Examples:

TOKENIZED:
- opens tokenized investment information
- shows eligibility and legal restrictions
- does not imply tokens are currently available unless approved

JV DEAL:
- opens JV terms or partner application
- does not route a retail investor into a JV flow

BUYER:
- opens buyer inquiry/purchase-interest workflow
- does not confuse buying the property with investing in the project

==================================================
5. DETAILS CONTROL
==================================================

Fix and verify the Details dropdown.

It must expand and collapse smoothly and show real deal information:

- project overview
- investment structure
- use of funds
- construction stage
- timeline
- capital target
- amount raised
- remaining allocation
- projected exit
- risks
- fees
- documents
- disclosures
- developer
- property address visibility rules
- update history

Test:

[ ] Open
[ ] Close
[ ] Rapid repeated taps
[ ] Scroll while expanded
[ ] Screen rotation where supported
[ ] Android
[ ] iOS
[ ] Web
[ ] In-app Instagram browser
[ ] Small screen
[ ] Large screen
[ ] Accessibility labels

Do not allow the expanded card to break scrolling or overlap the next card.

==================================================
6. VIEW DEAL FUNCTIONALITY
==================================================

`View Deal` must:

1. Resolve the correct canonical deal ID.
2. Open the correct deal detail page.
3. Preserve navigation history.
4. Load the same data shown on the card.
5. Show complete images and video.
6. Show documents according to user permission.
7. Show investment status.
8. Show legal disclosures.
9. Show real-time remaining availability.
10. Handle unavailable, closed, paused, or sold-out deals.

Test deep links from:

- landing page
- member home
- investor home
- Post card
- Reels card
- shared link
- notification
- email

No button may navigate using title matching or hardcoded route data.

==================================================
7. INVEST NOW FUNCTIONALITY
==================================================

`Invest Now` must execute a complete controlled workflow.

Required flow:

AUTH CHECK
→ USER PROFILE
→ INVESTOR ELIGIBILITY
→ KYC STATUS
→ OFFERING ELIGIBILITY
→ DEAL AVAILABILITY
→ INVESTMENT AMOUNT
→ OWNERSHIP PREVIEW
→ FEES
→ DISCLOSURES
→ AGREEMENT ACCEPTANCE
→ PAYMENT METHOD
→ PAYMENT AUTHORIZATION
→ TRANSACTION RECORD
→ OWNERSHIP RECORD
→ RECEIPT
→ PORTFOLIO UPDATE
→ NOTIFICATION
→ AUDIT EVENT

If user is not authenticated:

- preserve selected deal
- route to sign in or registration
- return to the same deal after authentication

If user is not eligible:

- explain exact next requirement
- do not initiate payment

If investment availability changed:

- revalidate server-side before payment

==================================================
8. PAYMENT ARCHITECTURE AUDIT
==================================================

Identify the actual payment provider and flow.

Return:

PAYMENT PROVIDER:
ENVIRONMENT:
LIVE / TEST:
API ROUTES:
WEBHOOK ROUTES:
SIGNATURE VERIFICATION:
IDEMPOTENCY:
CURRENCY:
SUPPORTED PAYMENT METHODS:
MINIMUM:
MAXIMUM:
FEE CALCULATION:
REFUND FLOW:
FAILURE FLOW:
PENDING FLOW:
CHARGEBACK FLOW:

Required transaction states:

CREATED
PENDING
REQUIRES_ACTION
AUTHORIZED
PROCESSING
COMPLETED
FAILED
CANCELLED
REFUNDED
PARTIALLY_REFUNDED
DISPUTED

Do not treat a client-side success screen as payment completion.

Only verified provider webhook confirmation may finalize a completed
financial transaction.

==================================================
9. ATOMIC TRANSACTION INTEGRITY
==================================================

On successful payment, update atomically:

- payment record
- transaction record
- investment record
- investor-deal relationship
- ownership allocation
- amount raised
- remaining allocation
- investor portfolio
- deal investor count
- activity feed
- receipt
- notification
- audit ledger

Prevent:

- double investment
- duplicate webhook processing
- duplicate ownership
- amount raised exceeding cap
- negative remaining allocation
- payment completed without ownership
- ownership created without payment
- stale card totals
- abandoned pending records remaining forever

Use:

- idempotency key
- database transaction
- row-level locking where appropriate
- unique constraints
- webhook event deduplication

==================================================
10. TOKENIZED TRANSACTION AUDIT
==================================================

If Tokenized investment is displayed, verify:

- legal status
- approved offering structure
- token availability
- security-token provider
- custody
- transfer restrictions
- investor eligibility
- jurisdiction restrictions
- KYC/AML requirement
- wallet requirement
- token issuance event
- token ownership ledger
- reconciliation with payment
- cancellation/refund behavior

Do not display a Tokenized badge as an active product if this functionality
is not yet legally and technically production-ready.

Use one of:

TOKENIZED_AVAILABLE
TOKENIZED_COMING_SOON
TOKENIZED_RESTRICTED
TOKENIZED_NOT_AVAILABLE

==================================================
11. POST CARD AUDIT
==================================================

Audit every regular Post card.

Required features:

- canonical author
- timestamp
- project/deal association
- media carousel
- captions
- tags
- like
- unlike
- comments
- comment count
- reply
- share
- deep link
- save
- unsave
- report
- visibility
- moderation
- deleted-content handling
- loading states
- retry states

Verify persistence after:

- refresh
- app restart
- logout/login
- second device
- backend restart

The Post card must not create fake engagement counts.

==================================================
12. REELS CARD AUDIT
==================================================

Audit every Reels card and investment overlay.

Required:

- correct deal association
- active video lifecycle
- poster
- play/pause
- mute/unmute
- progress
- replay
- swipe navigation
- comments
- likes
- shares
- saves
- deal detail link
- invest action
- investor count
- view count
- error recovery
- network recovery
- background/foreground recovery

Limit active video players and prevent:

- multiple simultaneous audio streams
- duplicate video instances
- memory growth
- stale player references
- disappearing Reels
- incorrect project media
- mixed Casa Rosario/Perez Residence assets
- jumping scroll
- overlay blocking navigation

Test at least 50 consecutive Reel swipes on a physical Android device.

==================================================
13. CROSS-CARD DATA SYNCHRONIZATION
==================================================

For the same deal, compare:

- landing investment card
- authenticated card
- detail page
- Post card
- Reels card
- owner dashboard
- investor dashboard
- Supabase record
- API response

Verify identical canonical values for:

- deal ID
- title
- media
- status
- capital target
- amount raised
- remaining allocation
- minimum investment
- ROI wording
- timeline
- developer
- badge eligibility
- investor count

A change in the owner dashboard must propagate consistently.

==================================================
14. DEVELOPER FIELD AUDIT
==================================================

The screenshot displays:

“Developed by Casa Rosario”

Audit this field.

Determine whether `Casa Rosario` is:

- project name
- legal development company
- sponsor
- issuer
- property owner
- marketing name

Display the correct legal/business entity.

Do not duplicate the project title as the developer unless that is true.

Return:

PROJECT:
DEVELOPER:
SPONSOR:
ISSUER:
PROPERTY OWNER:
DISPLAY LABEL:
SOURCE:

==================================================
15. ICON AND INTERACTION AUDIT
==================================================

Audit every icon:

- status indicator
- location
- sale price
- total investment
- ROI
- timeline
- ownership
- Tokenized
- JV
- Buyer
- developer
- dropdown arrow
- View Deal arrow
- like
- comment
- share/link
- save
- Reels

For every icon verify:

- meaning is clear
- press target is at least accessible size
- accessibility label exists
- disabled state exists
- loading state exists
- error state exists
- selected state exists
- count updates correctly
- dark theme contrast passes
- Android and iOS match
- no tap overlaps another control

==================================================
16. AUTHORIZATION AND SECURITY
==================================================

Verify server-side authorization for:

- anonymous visitors
- members
- investors
- buyers
- JV partners
- tokenized investors
- admins
- owner

Test:

- modifying deal ID
- modifying amount
- modifying ownership
- modifying price
- bypassing eligibility
- repeated payment request
- replaying webhook
- opening owner-only documents
- accessing another investor’s transaction
- client-side role spoofing
- expired token
- malformed token

Financial values must never be trusted from the client.

==================================================
17. FAILURE AND RECOVERY STATES
==================================================

Test:

- offline before tapping Invest Now
- network loss during checkout
- payment requires additional authentication
- payment declined
- payment pending
- duplicate tap
- app closed during payment
- webhook delayed
- backend restart
- database timeout
- deal becomes sold out
- minimum investment changes
- expired session
- KYC expires
- user navigates backward
- user returns from external payment

The app must recover without duplicate charges or lost transaction state.

==================================================
18. ANALYTICS AND AUDIT LEDGER
==================================================

Record:

- card impression
- image interaction
- Details open
- View Deal
- Invest Now
- authentication required
- eligibility blocked
- checkout started
- checkout abandoned
- payment initiated
- payment completed
- payment failed
- receipt viewed
- share
- like
- comment
- Reel viewed
- Reel-to-deal conversion

Do not store sensitive payment information in analytics.

Every financial event must include:

TRACE ID
USER ID
DEAL ID
TRANSACTION ID
PROVIDER EVENT ID
TIMESTAMP
STATUS
SOURCE CARD
APP VERSION
GIT SHA

==================================================
19. PERFORMANCE AND ACCESSIBILITY
==================================================

Required:

- skeleton loader
- image prefetch
- optimized image sizes
- cached thumbnails
- lazy loading
- stable card height
- no layout shift
- no jumping between media
- fast button response
- accessible text
- screen-reader labels
- dynamic text support
- adequate contrast
- no clipped controls
- safe-area support
- Instagram in-app browser compatibility

Measure:

CARD FIRST RENDER:
IMAGE LOAD:
DETAILS OPEN:
VIEW DEAL NAVIGATION:
CHECKOUT OPEN:
API LATENCY:
REELS START TIME:
MEMORY AFTER 50 REELS:

==================================================
20. REAL TEST DATA MATRIX
==================================================

Test at least:

- one active investment deal
- one paused deal
- one fully funded deal
- one closed deal
- one buyer-only property
- one JV-only deal
- one tokenized-eligible deal
- one non-tokenized deal
- anonymous visitor
- verified member
- verified investor
- buyer
- JV partner
- owner

Do not run production payment tests with uncontrolled real funds.

Use approved test transactions first, then one owner-approved low-value
live transaction if the provider and legal structure are production-ready.

==================================================
21. DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After fixing all defects:

1. Commit to the canonical owner repository.
2. Return full GitHub SHA.
3. Deploy backend.
4. Return Render deployment ID.
5. Verify `/health` HTTP 200.
6. Verify runtime SHA equals GitHub SHA.
7. Deploy landing/web changes.
8. Rebuild APK if mobile files changed.
9. Return EAS build ID.
10. Install the current APK on a physical Android device.
11. Clear stale cache only when necessary.
12. Verify the complete card flow live.

==================================================

==================================================
